failures.symptom: An old regression is treated as permanent product authority after intended behavior changes.
detection: Compare test expectation to newest accepted contract.
repair: Preserve history; obtain owning decision; update regression explicitly if contract changed.

failures.symptom: A stub/fixture/environment causes a failure not present on the real product surface.
repair: Fix/bound harness; withdraw unsupported product-defect claim.

failures.symptom: TESTED becomes VISUALLY_INSPECTED/PLAYTESTED or simulation becomes physical certification.
detection: Identify actual executor/observer and surface used.
repair: Downgrade label; record missing evidence explicitly.

failures.symptom: Evidence belongs to an older commit/artifact than the candidate being accepted.
repair: Retest current candidate or scope evidence to old version.

failures.symptom: Test locks incidental values/implementation rather than the accepted invariant.
repair: Restate invariant and redesign fixture or narrow claim.

failures.symptom: More automation is produced after the same unchanged claim already has sufficient machine evidence while a different evidence category remains missing.
detection: Compare evidence gap to existing accepted evidence.
repair: No-change or target the missing evidence surface.

failures.symptom: QA changes expected behavior, rule, UX, balance, or priority simply to resolve a test result.
detection: Check ownership map before changing expectation.
repair: Handoff evidence; retain HOLD until owning decision if material.

failures.symptom: One route/device/snapshot/browser is used to claim universal correctness or optimality.
detection: Compare claim scope with sample scope.
repair: Narrow claim or gather broader evidence.
